$comment: Operator-curated harness catalog (ADR-033 §1, schema revised by ADR-034 §'What R3.7.2 work is preserved' to make compose_profile optional). Entries: meshtasticd-3.x (R3.7.2.e′, ADR-034 process-local-testcontainer Approach via sandbox DooD).
$catalog_note: The meshtasticd-3.x entry's `name` is aspirational (anticipates a future 3.x release); the actual upstream Meshtastic project ships 2.7.x as of 2026-05. Smoke #8 run-10 surfaced the gap — builder correctly emitted needs_clarification when the previous `meshtastic/meshtasticd:3.5.0` tag returned 404 from Docker Hub. Image pinned to a real upstream tag (2.7.23-alpine — small, version-pinned, exists in registry). Future cleanup: rename `meshtasticd-3.x` → `meshtasticd-2.x` once we have time to update downstream persona/fixture references; for now the name stays so existing references don't break.

harnesses.name: meshtasticd-3.x
harnesses.domain_description: Real Meshtastic protocol over TCP, exposed by the upstream meshtasticd daemon (no hardware in the loop). Lifecycle managed in-process by Testcontainers under sandbox DooD (ADR-034 process-local-testcontainer Approach). Use this harness when work transcribes to behaviour at the meshtastic-protobuf wire boundary — POSITION_APP, NODEINFO_APP, TEXT_MESSAGE_APP, etc. Do NOT use this harness for RF-physics or LoRa-radio behaviour; meshtasticd is a daemon, not a radio simulator.
